name: Wraith

source.note: The 2024 Wraith. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against SRD 5.2.1 or the book. Unsure: the resistance list and whether Life Drain's Hit Point loss allows a save. Create Specter is text only.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.summary: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while in sunlight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.summary: Necrotic touch that also lowers the target's Hit Point maximum by the damage taken.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.summary: Raises a Humanoid that died violently within 10 ft in the last minute as a Specter it controls (seven at most).

summary: A shadow of hatred that passes through walls, drains life with a touch and raises its victims as specters.
